capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate a PreToolUse hook observes and denies a tool call that reaches execution.
capabilities.description: A PreToolUse hook (matcher "*"/""/none) observes and can block tool calls that reach execution.
capabilities.failure_behavior: No pre-execution enforcement; dkskill must refuse certified enforcement on this host (H-Q1).
limitations: Only calls that reach execution are seen; calls rejected earlier by native validation/deny never reach PreToolUse (U-20).
capabilities.name: PreToolUse interception
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Hook protocol may change across versions; re-verify per profile.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate a PostToolUse hook fires with the executed tool call.
capabilities.description: A PostToolUse hook observes tool calls after execution (post-hoc observation, not prevention).
capabilities.failure_behavior: No post-execution observation; reconciliation/audit degrades; enforcement relies on PreToolUse.
limitations: Post-hoc only: cannot prevent the side effect; shares V-01 evidence with PreToolUse rather than an independent experiment.
capabilities.name: PostToolUse interception
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Hook protocol may change across versions.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate hook events for subagent tool calls include agent_id/agent_type.
capabilities.description: Hooks observe tool calls inside subagents; events carry agent_id and agent_type.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Subagent actions unpoliced; refuse certified enforcement for subagent scenarios (H-Q1).
limitations: Subagent calls rejected earlier by native validation never reach the hook (U-20).
capabilities.name: Subagent tool-call interception
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Subagent event shape may change across versions.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile and per MCP server type: demonstrate matcher interception.
capabilities.description: Hook matchers (mcp__.* and "*") intercept MCP tool calls.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Unmatched MCP calls are unpoliced; refuse certified enforcement for those MCP types.
limitations: Verified for local stdio MCP servers only; other MCP server types (plugin/remote) untested (U-01). Only tools whose names match the pattern are covered.
capabilities.name: MCP tool matchers
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: MCP wiring and server types vary; re-verify per type/version.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate a deny with a model-visible reason.
capabilities.description: A hook can block a call (exit 2 or permissionDecision:"deny") with a reason the model sees.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Denials without a visible reason; model cannot self-correct; refuse certified enforcement.
capabilities.name: Hook deny reason visibility
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Decision protocol may change across versions.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate deny/ask beats allow.
capabilities.description: allow cannot override stronger deny/ask rules or managed permissions.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Precedence unreliable; enforcement cannot be trusted; refuse certified enforcement.
limitations: dkskill never emits allow (MASTER-SPEC S-9); a foreign hook allow can loosen native checks and is reported (V-16/U-16).
capabilities.name: allow/deny/ask precedence
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Permission model may change across versions.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate narrowing and (future) multi-hook composition.
capabilities.description: A hook can narrow (normalize/restrict) tool input via updatedInput.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Optional narrowing unavailable; dkskill omits the feature; core enforcement unaffected.
limitations: Only narrowing normalizations demonstrated; composition of updatedInput across multiple hooks is untested (U-07).
capabilities.name: updatedInput narrowing
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Hook input-rewrite semantics may change.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate tool-list enforcement for local and plugin agents.
capabilities.description: Subagent tools allowlist and disallowedTools denylist (incl mcp__*) are enforced; nesting has a depth limit.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Subagent tool restrictions unenforced; refuse certified enforcement for subagent tool policy.
limitations: Plugin agents honor tools/disallowedTools but ignore their frontmatter hooks/permissionMode/mcpServers (V-22/U-05); role policy must come from global/plugin-level hooks keyed on agent_type.
capabilities.name: Subagent tools/disallowedTools enforcement
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Agent frontmatter handling may change across versions.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate Skill invocation and the invocation-restriction flags.
capabilities.description: The Skill tool invokes skills; disable-model-invocation and user-invocable flags restrict invocation.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Skill invocation controls unavailable; dkskill limits skill-based features.
limitations: No mechanism hides a skill from both model and user while allowing runtime invocation (V-08).
capabilities.name: Skill tool and invocation flags
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Skill flag semantics may change across versions.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate the identifier set is present in hook input/env.
capabilities.description: Hooks run as separate processes with session_id, prompt_id, agent_id, transcript_path; CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA is persistent plugin storage.
capabilities.failure_behavior: dkskill cannot correlate events/state; enforcement correlation degrades; refuse where correlation is required.
limitations: No general runtime-state API; dkskill owns its state.
capabilities.name: Hook environment identifiers
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Identifier set may change across versions.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate settings precedence (deny beats allow).
capabilities.description: Settings allow/deny/ask rules apply and deny beats allow across the settings hierarchy.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Settings-based policy unreliable; refuse certified enforcement.
capabilities.name: Settings precedence
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Settings hierarchy may change across versions.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile with org deployment: demonstrate managed settings restrict permissions/bypass modes.
capabilities.description: Managed (organization) settings can restrict permissions and bypass modes.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Managed-settings hardening unavailable; dkskill relies on user/project settings; refuse claims that depend on managed settings.
limitations: Mechanism documented but requires organizational deployment; not validated hands-on in the isolated environment (U-13).
capabilities.name: Managed settings
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Managed-settings support varies by deployment/version.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate a ceiling restriction holds and identify the default mode/classifier behavior.
capabilities.description: dkskill can impose autonomy restrictions on top of the host permission mode (restrict-only ceiling).
capabilities.failure_behavior: Autonomy ceiling unenforceable; refuse certified enforcement of autonomy limits.
limitations: Ceiling only: restrict, never grant. On 2.1.283 the default mode is auto and its classifier may approve routine actions; bypassPermissions loosens checks.
capabilities.name: Permission-mode ceiling and default behavior
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Default mode and classifier behavior are version-sensitive (auto on 2.1.283).

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: enumerate protected paths and demonstrate protection under the default mode.
capabilities.description: The host protects some configuration paths (.claude/, ~/.claude/, .git, .mcp.json, shell rc files).
capabilities.failure_behavior: Config paths writable; dkskill must protect its own state independently.
limitations: dkskill-owned state is not covered by native protection. In auto mode the classifier decides protected writes; bypassPermissions allows them.
capabilities.name: Protected configuration paths
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Protected-path set and mode behavior vary by version.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate concurrent hook execution and order-independence.
capabilities.description: Multiple hooks on one event all run concurrently; start order follows configuration order; completion order is non-deterministic.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Coexistence with foreign hooks unreliable; refuse certified enforcement where order matters.
limitations: dkskill must be order-independent; it cannot rely on running first or on completion order (U-16).
capabilities.name: Multiple hook concurrency
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Concurrency model may change across versions.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate deny precedence (exit 2 blocks; settings deny beats hook allow).
capabilities.description: Deny beats allow; a settings deny beats a hook allow; exit 2 blocks; exit 1 is non-blocking.
capabilities.failure_behavior: A deny may not hold; enforcement cannot be trusted; refuse certified enforcement.
limitations: A hook allow can loosen native checks (it overrode a working-directory block), so dkskill never emits allow and reports foreign allow (U-16).
capabilities.name: Deny precedence across hooks
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Decision-combination rules may change across versions.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate Stop-hook blocking and stop_hook_active handling.
capabilities.description: A Stop hook can block turn end and coexists with other Stop hooks; loop guard is stop_hook_active.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Turn-end gating unavailable; dkskill loses end-of-turn checks; degrade to pre-execution gating.
limitations: The gate must honor stop_hook_active to avoid loops (U-12).
capabilities.name: Stop hook blocking
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Stop-hook protocol may change across versions.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate SessionStart context delivery and the size limit.
capabilities.description: SessionStart additionalContext reaches the model at startup; each new session gets its own.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Session rules not delivered; dkskill cannot brief the model; refuse certified enforcement that depends on the brief.
limitations: Content must be ≤ ~9,000 characters; larger content is silently truncated (U-06).
capabilities.name: SessionStart context injection
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Context delivery and size limit vary by version.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate context redelivery on compaction.
capabilities.description: SessionStart additionalContext is re-delivered after compaction (source: compact).
capabilities.failure_behavior: Rules lost after compaction; long sessions become unbriefed; refuse certified enforcement for long sessions.
limitations: Shares the ≤ ~9,000-character limit (U-06); relies on the compaction event firing SessionStart.
capabilities.name: Context redelivery after compaction
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Compaction event behavior is version-sensitive.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate live reload and ConfigChange emission.
capabilities.description: User-scope settings/hook changes apply to a running session within ~1s and emit ConfigChange.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Live reconfiguration unavailable; dkskill requires session restart for config changes.
limitations: Verified at user scope; anything that can write the settings file changes live enforcement — watch ConfigChange (U-04).
capabilities.name: Configuration reload
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Reload timing/event may change across versions.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: demonstrate the nonce heartbeat detects hook presence/absence.
capabilities.description: A runtime command can detect whether PreToolUse saw its own call (nonce heartbeat) — the T2 self-check base.
capabilities.failure_behavior: dkskill cannot confirm its hooks are active; per H-Q1 it must refuse certified enforcement (DEGRADED_AT_RUNTIME if a certified profile then fails T2).
limitations: Detects missing hooks; it does not prevent them being disabled (U-09).
capabilities.name: Hook-presence heartbeat
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Heartbeat mechanism depends on hook protocol/version.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: record the timeout behavior; certification must document fail-open and the compensating internal deadline.
capabilities.description: On PreToolUse hook timeout the hook is cancelled and the tool call PROCEEDS (fail-open).
capabilities.failure_behavior: On timeout the action executes unchecked; dkskill must self-bound its hook runtime and record the fail-open posture.
limitations: KNOWN CRITICAL LIMITATION: fail-open. dkskill hooks need an internal deadline well below the configured timeout (V-21/U-10).
capabilities.name: Hook timeout semantics (fails open)
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: Timeout behavior is platform/version-sensitive (verified on Windows/2.1.283 only).

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: capture stream samples and confirm the schema (stream@N facet) on the pinned version.
capabilities.description: The host emits a stream-json event schema the harness/HCL can parse (the stream@N facet).
capabilities.failure_behavior: Unparseable events are anomalies; attribution/scoring cannot proceed; refuse certified attribution.
limitations: Parsed against the Phase 2/3 corpus for 2.1.283 only; unknown types/fields are anomalies, never guessed. Not validated for other versions (TS-07/U-17).
capabilities.name: stream-json event schema
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: HIGH: revalidate per version (TS-07). Frozen benchmark pin is 2.1.283.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Per host profile: re-derive/confirm attr@N against captured permission events on the pinned version.
capabilities.description: Denial/permission message strings map to attribution classes (the attr@N facet).
capabilities.failure_behavior: Errors attributed A9/unknown; attribution completeness drops; refuse certified attribution for that version.
limitations: attr@1 is valid ONLY for Claude Code 2.1.283 (ATTR_VALID_FOR); on any other version every error is A9/unknown until the table is re-derived. TS-07 UNRESOLVED.
capabilities.name: Permission/attribution text (attr@N)
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: HIGH: attr table is version-pinned; a new version requires re-derivation (TS-07). Frozen: attr@1 = 2.1.283.

capabilities.certification_requirement: Future: implement and validate a reliable identity probe (product/version/platform/channel) with recorded evidence.
capabilities.description: The HCL identity probe determines the host product, version, platform and release channel to resolve a compatibility profile (T1).
capabilities.failure_behavior: No identity => no profile match => UNVERIFIED host => refuse certified enforcement (H-Q1).
limitations: Proposed in the owner review (§5 T1) but not implemented or validated. A benchmark environment snapshot is listed as a harness piece not yet built. Channel detection has no evidence.
capabilities.name: Host identity / version / platform / channel detection
capabilities.platform_version_sensitivity: By definition detects platform/version/channel; must be validated per platform.

metadata.dependency_model: dkskill feature -> required capabilities -> host compatibility profile -> facet adapter -> evidence/certification. Data/specification relationship only; the HCL and runtime resolver are NOT implemented in M0.

distinctions.certified_for_production: A signed certification record exists for the host profile (H-Q4/H-Q6). M0 certifies nothing.
distinctions.known_to_exist: The capability exists on some host (evidence recorded).
distinctions.required_by_feature: A dkskill feature depends on the capability (dependency model).
distinctions.validated_for_profile: The capability is VERIFIED for a specific host compatibility profile.

frozen_phase4_state.note: M0 changes none of the above; it certifies no version or platform.

owner_architecture.H-Q2: Support the latest 3 CERTIFIED versions initially; expandable by explicit owner decision.
owner_architecture.H-Q3: Windows, macOS, Linux in certification scope with certified Claude Code channels.
owner_architecture.H-Q4: Every certified host version/facet gets an immutable compatibility profile and attribution record.
owner_architecture.H-Q5: Approved benchmark binaries preserved as immutable artifacts (product/version/platform/channel/SHA-256).
owner_architecture.H-Q6: Compatibility registry requires signed updates; certification/signing authority is the PTPL/dkskill owner.
owner_architecture.H-Q7: Certification environments are separate from the Phase 4 benchmark environment.

metadata.purpose: Canonical, version-independent capability vocabulary for the future dkskill Host Compatibility Layer (HCL). Design/spec only; no runtime consumers.
metadata.safety_semantics: UNVERIFIED != UNSUPPORTED. However, an UNVERIFIED safety-critical capability means dkskill MUST NOT claim certified enforcement on that host (H-Q1: refuse enforcement on unverified hosts).

state_semantics.DEGRADED_AT_RUNTIME: A certified profile claims the capability but a live T2 self-check failed this session; the T2 failure overrides the certified claim for that session. (Runtime-only state; no capability is catalogued in this state.)
state_semantics.NOT_AVAILABLE: Demonstrated to be absent on the relevant host/platform.
state_semantics.NOT_YET_VALIDATED: No sufficient current evidence; a defined future validation is required (maps to the owner review NOT_VERIFIED).
state_semantics.PARTIALLY_VERIFIED: Demonstrated only in part or under stated limits.
state_semantics.VERIFIED: Capability demonstrated by recorded evidence for a specific host identity (here, the Phase 2 hands-on identity / benchmark pin 2.1.283).

metadata.title: dkskill Capability Catalogue (M0)
metadata.version_independence: Capability IDs are stable semantic identities and are NEVER tied to a single Claude Code version (no CAP-CC-2.1.283-* IDs). A new version normally adds a compatibility profile/facet when behavior differs; it does not create a new capability.
